p2_b3.ocr: The Gastrointestinal tract indicates controversy in α-syn pathology, with NA for structural and functional imaging, and decreased 11C-donepezil standard uptake values in the small intestine and pancreas following a rostral-caudal gradient for molecular imaging. The Olfactory bulb has a positive α-syn pathology characterized by bilateral reduction of olfactory bulb volume in structural imaging, with NA for functional and molecular imaging. The Olfactory tract also shows positive α-syn pathology, with bilateral increase of mean diffusivity in structural imaging and NA for the other imaging types.

p2_b4.ocr: The Olfactory cortex reveals positive α-syn pathology, a decrease of olfactory sulcus depth, and decrease of piriform cortex volume in structural imaging, reduced activation in the amygdala and hippocampal formation after olfactory stimulation in functional imaging, and reduced glucose metabolism in bilateral medial prefrontal cortex and parieto-occipito-temporal cortex in molecular imaging, along with positive correlations between UPSIT scores and various activities across multiple brain regions.
